page.overview:
What is Nísimaldar?

Nísimaldar was a wooded area surrounding the coastal city of Eldalondë in the western part of Númenor.

Nísimaldar was noted for its beautiful evergreen and fragrant trees, which the Elves of Tol Eressëa brought out of the West (See: Plants of Númenor). It was also the only place that the golden tree malinornë as well as others of the Mallorn strain grew.

The place was a great treasure to both Men and Elves who took great delight in the many sweet smells that filled the air there.

The name Nísimaldar means "fragrant trees", from the Quenya terms nísima ("fragrant") and alda ("tree").
